verdict.rationale: Vestd's help docs say option holders submit their exercise request through the platform, and a company admin then reviews and processes it. Vestd separately documents paperless digital share issuance, but nothing explicitly ties that to the exercise flow. Missing for 10: documented online payment of the exercise price, an explicit link between exercise and automatic share issuance, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end paperless flow.

support.subject: As an employee, I can exercise my vested options online — including payment and the resulting share issuance — without paper forms

citations.quote: When a recipient is ready to exercise their options, they submit a request through Vestd.
The company's admin user then reviews and processes it, confirming the company valuation and any relevant tax or legal considerations.
Authorise and issue new shares digitally, and update Companies House in the click of a button. No paperwork involved!
